test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A truck covers a distance of 540 km at a certain speed in 9 hours. How much time would a car take at an average speed which is 16 km/hr more than that of the speed of the truck to cover a distance which is 68 km more than that travelled by the truck?
solution:
**Given Data:**

Truck distance: 540 km in 9 hours

Car distance: 68 km more, speed 16 km/hr more

**Concept:**

Calculate the time using the formula Time = (Distance)/(Speed)

**Solution:**

⇒ Truck speed = (540)/(9)=60 km/hr

⇒ Car speed = 60 + 16 = 76 km/hr

⇒ Car distance = 540 + 68 = 608 km

⇒ Car time = (608)/(76)=8 hours

**Therefore, the car would take 8 hours.**
